say:1:1730510001:1.text: First time here? Azure Tokens are the currency here.
say:1:1730510001:1.source_cn: 第一次来？在会馆里青符就相当于银币。
say:1:1730510001:1.male: First time here? Azure Tokens are the currency here.
say:1:1730510001:1.female: First time here? Azure Tokens are the currency here.

say:2:1730510002:1.text: You can use them to play games or exchange them for goods.
say:2:1730510002:1.source_cn: 拿着青符，你想打牌就打牌，不想打牌就可以拿青符换各种东西。
say:2:1730510002:1.male: You can use them to play games or exchange them for goods.
say:2:1730510002:1.female: You can use them to play games or exchange them for goods.

say:3:1730510003:1.text: If you don't have any, all you can do is watch others play.
say:3:1730510003:1.source_cn: 没有青符的话，你就只能在牌桌边看着别人快乐。
say:3:1730510003:1.male: If you don't have any, all you can do is watch others play.
say:3:1730510003:1.female: If you don't have any, all you can do is watch others play.
